name: KL-UCB
tagline: Bernoulli KL upper-confidence bound: pull arm maximizing the largest q with N*KL(mu_hat,q) <= log t.
formula: $$U_a(t) = \sup\{q\in[0,1] : N_a(t)\,\mathrm{KL}_{\mathrm{Ber}}(\hat\mu_a, q) \le c\,\log t\},\quad c = 1;\qquad a_t = \arg\max_a U_a(t)$$
diff_from_baseline: Garivier & Cappe 2011 (COLT); Cappe, Garivier, Maillard, Munos & Stoltz 2013 (Annals of Statistics). KL-divergence-based UCB matches the Lai-Robbins lower bound for Bernoulli bandits; canonical asymptotically-optimal MAB baseline.

name: Thompson Sampling
tagline: Beta posterior per arm for MAB; LinTS Sherman-Morrison updates for contextual; discounted Beta for non-stationary.
pseudocode:
1. Init $\alpha_a=\beta_a=1$ for each arm; (LinTS) $B_a^{-1}=I/\lambda$, $f_a=0$, $\hat\theta_a=0$
2. select_arm(t, ctx): if ctx given, sample $\theta_a\sim\mathcal{N}(\hat\theta_a, v^2 B_a^{-1})$ via Cholesky; pick $\arg\max_a \langle ctx,\theta_a\rangle$
3. else sample $s_a \sim \mathrm{Beta}(\alpha_a,\beta_a)$, pick $\arg\max_a s_a$
4. update(arm, r, ctx): if ctx, Sherman-Morrison $B_a^{-1} \mathrel{-}= \frac{B_a^{-1}xx^\top B_a^{-1}}{1 + x^\top B_a^{-1}x}$, $f_a += r\,x$, $\hat\theta_a = B_a^{-1}f_a$
5. else discount: $\alpha,\beta \mathrel{*}= \gamma$ (clamped to >=1); $\alpha_{\text{arm}} += r$, $\beta_{\text{arm}} += 1-r$
diff_from_baseline: Thompson 1933 (Biometrika); Agrawal & Goyal 2012 (COLT) for MAB; Agrawal & Goyal 2013 (ICML) for LinTS. Bayesian probability-matching: posterior sampling per arm. Default baseline for Bernoulli/contextual bandits; near-optimal in practice.

name: UCB1
tagline: Auer-Cesa-Bianchi-Fischer upper confidence bound: pull arm maximizing empirical mean plus exploration bonus.
diff_from_baseline: Auer, Cesa-Bianchi & Fischer 2002 (Machine Learning). Foundational UCB algorithm; logarithmic regret on stationary stochastic MAB. Falls back to per-arm UCB1 for contextual settings (no context use). The implementation also maintains a sliding-window buffer (Garivier & Moulines 2011 SW-UCB) that is intentionally NOT used so vanilla UCB1 behavior is preserved.
